title: DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Siren Detection
description: Detect the sound of emergency vehicle sirens in the vicinity of a microphone
long_description: Strengthen situational awareness with the DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Model for Siren Detection. Designed for smooth edge deployment, it reliably detects emergency vehicle sirens in real time, enabling microphone-equipped devices to respond intelligently to critical events and changing environments.
